reviewed_story: Candice Tucker’s Windows host (10.11.11.203, TUCKER-WIN7-PC) downloaded a Windows executable from acjabogados[.]com/40group.tiff. The recovered hash matches the publisher’s sample. Subsequent TCP attempts targeted 5.188.108[.]58 and 138.201.6[.]195 without a response. These are attempted connections, not proof of a successful command-and-control session.
matched: Correct victim, identity, disguised payload URL and SHA-256.
gaps: Omits the subsequent connection attempts. The exact payload is not included in the short IOC list; the new extension-mismatch rule does not yet cover .tiff.
